name: Kernobee
summary: Deep within Gnomeregan, Kernobee is trapped among the ruins. The goblin engineer uncovered Dark Iron involvement in the super rig, then was captured, beaten unconscious, and left in the dormitory quarters among the troggs.

sections.title: A Deadly Discovery
sections.body: While doing business or scavenging in Gnomeregan, Kernobee discovered the Dark Iron dwarves had helped build and operate the great super rig burrowing beneath the city. Knowing how dangerous this knowledge was, he tried to flee to Ratchet and warn his associate, Tinkerwiz. The Dark Irons caught him before he could escape.

sections.title: Left for the Troggs
sections.body: Kernobee's captors beat him unconscious instead of killing him. They threw him into a small room along the dormitory corridor, opposite the Clean Zone. Feral troggs and radiation surround him, and he needs help to wake, reach safety, and get clear of the ruins.

faq.answer: Kernobee is a goblin operative found unconscious in Gnomeregan's dormitory sector. He works closely with Tinkerwiz in Ratchet and entered the ruins before his attackers caught him.

faq.q: Why was Kernobee imprisoned in Gnomeregan?
aliases: why did dark irons capture him
faq.answer: Kernobee discovered the Dark Iron clan was helping build subterranean super rig machines inside Gnomeregan. The Dark Irons knocked him unconscious and threw him into the dormitory to die, keeping their presence and sabotage quiet.
Kernobee reports to Tinkerwiz, a goblin engineer in Ratchet, the neutral port town across the sea in the Barrens.

faq.q: Where in Gnomeregan is Kernobee located?
faq.answer: Kernobee lies unconscious in a small side room on the Dormitory's lower level, on its western side directly across from the Clean Zone.

angles.text: For gnomes fighting to reclaim their homeland, Kernobee's discovery shows that Dark Iron dwarves aided their catastrophe from the shadows.
As an engineer, you can understand the danger of exploring experimental subterranean machinery like the Dark Iron rigs while rival schematics are at stake.
